question: What is our institution-wide placement percentage for 2025-26, and how does it compare to the strategic-plan target?
answer: Institution-wide placement for academic year 2025-26 is 75.12%, computed as sum(placed_students) / sum(eligible_students) x 100 over 8 departments (sum(placed_students)=779, sum(eligible_students)=1037). The Strategic Plan 2024-27 target is 80.00%, so we are 4.88 percentage points below it — status: below target. Source: Placement Cell tracker.
